newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Merged Metway earnings seen jumping.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Merged Metway earnings seen jumping.

text.p: Metway Bank Ltd's net profit including synergies from its planned merger with businesses owned by the Queensland government is estimated at A$175.6 million in the year to June 30, 1997, Grant Samuel and Associates said in an independent experts report on Wednesday,

Metway plans to merge with Queensland Industry Development Corp (QIDC) and Suncorp Finance, both owned by the Queensland government, to create an enlarged group with a market value of about A$2.2 billion.
Metway reported a net profit of A$41.69 million in the year to June 30, 1996.
Grant Samuel estimated net profit including merger synergies for the enlarged Metway would rise to A$217.9 million in 1997/98 and A$247.0 million in 1998/99.
It said the "notional earnings estimates" for the Suncorp-Metway group have been prepared as part of the process to establish merger terms.
Suncorp reported a net profit after abnormals of A$201.2 million in 1995/96, up from A$101.1 million in 1994/95.
